ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.20 high-intensity (white/light-gray) to 0.80 low-intensity (black/dark-gray) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark-gray substrate with light-gray/white mottled streaks radiating from the median notch toward the lateral tips. Concentrated high-intensity white contiguous zones are localized at both fluke tips and along sections of the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch; approximate pixel angle of 55 degrees; depth relative to lobe vertical span is significant (estimated 15-20% penetration).
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration pattern. Left lobe shows continuous jagged peaks. Right lobe features a prominent, large-amplitude smooth concave excision (missing tissue) immediately adjacent to the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep trajectory along the trailing edge of both lobes, with the lateral tips exhibiting a slightly upward posterior curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Isolated white circular pixel clusters (likely barnacle scars) detected near the central peduncle insertion point and the lower margin of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct parallel white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) localized on the trailing edge of both fluke tips; approximately 5-7 parallel marks visible on the right distal tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant traumatic indentation/excision on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe near the notch. Extensive parallel linear rake scarring on the distal trailing edges of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-contrast 'comb' pattern formed by parallel white scars on the extreme distal margin of the right fluke tip.
